page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.c2 family. It is configured with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor and features 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a one-to-one ratio of vCPUs to memory, the ecs.c2.medium is structured for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance by avoiding resource contention. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for CPU-bound tasks such as high-performance computing, batch processing, and compute-intensive simulations where memory overhead is minimal.

The dedicated CPU allocation makes it suitable for compute-intensive workloads, batch processing, and parallel computing tasks that require predictable CPU performance but have low memory capacity requirements.
